verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS collaboration app and its developer CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out for the Slack app, CLI, or MCP server. Admin approval of MCP clients and data-export features are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
